integrity: Analytic proof with defined parameters; standalone finite-check diagnostics are corroborating only, not substitutes for quantifier proof.
scientific_limitations: Only a single ordinary reproducing kernel, positive real binomial amplitude, standard power-weighted analytic Bergman disk and integer degree m>=2. A complex amplitude is obtained by rotation. No general polynomial or multikernel claim. Historical priority conditional on sources read.
title: A first-order sampling-site transition for sparse weighted Bergman kernel approximation
